name: Pact Wizard (CR 7)
body:
PACT WIZARD
CR 7

Human abjurer (pact wizard) 7
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception -3

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 41 (7d6+14)
Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +7
Defensive Abilities energy absorption 21/day, protective ward 7/day (4 rounds, +2), resistance; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee adamantine dagger +4 (1d4, 19-20)
Ranged adamantine dagger +5 (1d4, 19-20)
Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 7th, concentration +11)

4th Level–emergency force sphere, hypercognition, lesser globe of invulnerability
3rd Level–ablative barrier, dispel magic, fireball (DC 17), magic circle against evil
2nd Level–acid arrow, flaming sphere (DC 16), levitate, page-bound epiphany, resist energy
1st Level–alarm, burning hands (DC 15), magic missile, protection from evil, shield, shocking grasp
0-Level–detect magic, ray of frost, read magic, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 12, Con 14, Int 19, Wis 14, Cha 12
Base Atk +3; CMB +7; CMD 18
Traits Avid Reader (Knowledge– arcana), Classically Schooled, Star Struck (The Noble Prince- Charisma); Drawbacks Dependent
Feats Avid Spellbook Reader, Careful Reader, Combat Casting, Eschew Materials, Spell Focus (abjuration)
Skills Diplomacy +8, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (planes) +14, Knowledge (religion) +27, Linguistics +14, Profession (scribe) +12, Spellcraft +15/+17
Languages Celestial, Common, Dwarven, Elven, Sylvan
SQ arcane bond (dagger), effortless magic, great power, greater expense (Voices TS27), opposition schools (Illusion, Necromancy), patron spells (Mind)
Gear amulet of natural armor +2 (8,000 gp), adamantine dagger (3,002 gp), chronicler’s kit (40 gp), headband of vast intelligence +2 (4,000 gp), potion of cure moderate wounds (300 gp), staff of minor arcana (8,000 gp), 2 thunderstones (100 gp), tome of epics (50 gp), wizard’s kit (21 gp)
